We haven't really dined at the hotels too much...we really need to change that because I hear they are amazing. Which one is your favorite?

Boma - Flavors of Africa for breakfast. Hands down. They have an egg, spinach, goats cheese dish that I know make at home. Still not as good as theirs.

California Grill for dinner. You have to be willing to eat late (9:00pm) since they have balconies to watch the Magic Kingdom Fireworks at night after you eat. 10/10

Disney's Spirit of Aloha Dinner Show Another dinner. Plus complementary wine (if that's your thing). However this is also good for kids in the sense of it's a more relaxed environment.

Yachtsman Steakhouse Last diner one. You want the Kansas City Strip Steak. What I would do for that cut regularly.

I would suggest the meal plan if you go. For two adults (Besides Boma) meals easily got to $150.00 but I only had to pay tip while there.

I need to warn you though. It's kinda hard to eat in the parks once you've ate at the resorts. Which is why I like Epcot's world showcast food, but not much of the other parks. I haven't had the Gaston restaurant in Magic Kingdom yet so I cannot comment on that.
